dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Faint horizontal bands formed by the pale tips of greater and median coverts, though these are integrated into the overall scalloped dorsal pattern.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Visible pale edges on folded flight feathers create stacked, curved boundaries with moderate sharpness against darker feather bodies.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced pale-colored fringes on mantle, scapulars, and wing coverts creating a repetitive, high-contrast scalloped effect.
